body.statement: For every \(a\), \(h\in\mathcal H_a(P)\), \(q\in\mathcal Q_a(P)\), \(u\in\mathcal N_a(P)\), and \(m\in\mathcal K_a(P)\) on the square-integrable product domain, \[S_a(h+u,q+m)-S_a(h,q)=F_a(h,m)-G_a(q,u)-R_a(m,u).\] Pure shifts and the four-corner contrast recover the three terms separately, so \[\mathcal C_P=\overline{\operatorname{span}}\{\phi-\phi':\phi,\phi'\in\Phi_P\}\quad\text{and}\quad\mathcal A_P=\phi_0+\mathcal C_P\] for every \(\phi_0\in\Phi_P\).
body.justification: The identity isolates the interaction normal missed by optimizing over one bridge coordinate at a time.
body.gap: BennettEtAl2026StronglyIdentified proves the mixed-bias identity for a fixed primal-dual pair; it does not identify the closed affine geometry generated by all nonunique proximal pairs.
body.consumer: The identity converts a normal-equation projection into an implementable affine ensemble of ordinary proximal doubly robust signals.
